description: Return the organization name, token name, and truncated token preview for the API key currently configured on the MCP server. Useful for confirming which account is in use before performing credit-consuming operations.
name: whoami

organization_name.description: Display name of the organization that owns the token.

token_name.description: User-assigned name of the API token authenticating the request.

token_preview.description: Truncated preview of the API token (e.g. `cwbl_…xyz`). Safe to display; does not authenticate.

title: Identify the API token
